results.title: Designing supplying Installation And Commissioning of Musical Fountain with Multimedia Show On Water Screen At Khumb Mela 2027 Haridwar
results.content: Specific tender notice mirrored by BidEasy for Haridwar-Roorkee Development Authority, Uttarakhand; tender ID 2026_HRDA_101761_1. Scope covers design, supply, installation and commissioning of a musical fountain with a multimedia water-screen show for Kumbh Mela 2027. Stated bid deadline: 12 November 2026. Estimated value: ₹3.73 crore.

results.title: Special Repairs to the Footpath arrangements around Musical Fountain in Upper park at Mettur Dam
results.content: Specific Tamil Nadu Water Resources Department notice on an independent tender mirror; tender ID 2026_WRD_716639_1. Scope is footpath repairs around the musical fountain at Mettur Dam, rather than fountain installation. Stated bid deadline: 11 November 2026 at 3:00 PM. Estimated value: ₹3,75,109. The linked government notice could not be fetched.
